text: Grandad here, looking after my grandson who's 2. I'm worried sick to be honest. Temp is 38.2. He hadn't been for a poo for 3 days and was grumpy as anything about it, and now tonight when it finally came it was all runny. He's drinking plenty though and his nappies are wet like normal. He's wide awake, chatting to me and watching his cartoons, so that's something. Is the runny poo after not going a bad sign or am I worrying over nothing
